selection.rule_text: 1) Pick the fitting set by inside carcase height (5 ranges, 440-925 mm). 2) Pick gas spring pair from the table by inside carcase height range and exact flap weight incl. handle (total of both flaps); if two springs fit choose the stronger. notes: All Lift Advanced numbers come from official Hettich documents (S1-S6). Spring tables were parsed from the PDF text layer by script and spot-checked against S3/S4 and S6 (HK identical in 2023 catalogue).
Page numbers 'S1 p.N' are printed catalogue page numbers (PDF page = N - 318).

Lift Advanced is the current lift/flap range (HF bi-fold, HK swing-up, HL parallel lift, HS lift-up); HK still in TA 2023 catalogue. The shop lists Lift Advanced HF/HK/HL/HS as available (search result). I could not confirm HF/HL/HS in 2023 catalogue pages.
Hettich has no 'Lift Premium' or 'Easys' lift in the documents found; not included.
The Furniture Fittings catalogue 2016 volume 2 (drilling jigs) was not fetched; carcase drilling datum should be checked on the jig or on page images S1 p.327.
Carcase hole pattern ø5x12: dims 118, 75, 22, 41, 85 mm as drawn; datum NOT stated in text, identical for HF/HK/HL/HS (S7).
Hinge for HF/HK/HL: min. 90 mm from carcase side inner edge (S2 p.12).
Fitting bag: 4 brass expansion sleeves hex head (hole ø10x12 in flap), 4 M6 socket screws (arm to flap), 6 Euro screws Pozidriv (carcase holes ø5x12), 2 hex keys (S2 p.12).
Spring forces have a tolerance of 15 percent and spring must be fitted with piston rod down (S2 p.7-9).
Hinge note for HK: hinges 95 or 110 deg; Sensys usable (276-360 mm only from 12.4 kg; 360-720 all weights) (S2 p.5).
Sensys vs no push-to-open or electric: no such Lift Advanced variants in the sources.
